d:
Happy Diwali, Everyone!
By popular demand, I’m thrilled to share the full encore performance of Tumhi Dekho Naa (Lofi Sitar), recorded live in Mumbai during the Sitar for Mental Health tour.
Song: Tumhi Dekho Naa (Sitar Lofi)
Film: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
Artists: Rishab Rikhiram Sharma, Shankar Ehsaan Loy
Venue: NCPA Auditorium, Mumbai
Recorded on: March 10, 2024
